summary: Completed frontend testing of Auditions page and Profile page video upload modal. Fixed duplicate swipe hint bug. All requested features verified working.

issues: Spotify embed shows 'Application error: a client-side exception has occurred' - external Spotify embed issue, not app code

passed_tests: Auditions page loads with video content (6 sample videos)
Auditions page shows single 'Swipe up for more' hint (FIXED - was showing 6 duplicates)
Video index dots display at top showing user's video count (6 dots visible)
Share button opens modal with Facebook, Instagram, X, Reddit, and Copy Link options
Filter button present and opens genre filter modal
Category filter tabs work (Featured, Musicians, Audio Engineers, Studios, Venues, Merchants, Comedians, Actors)
Musicians subcategory dropdown shows options (Accordion, Acoustic Guitar, Bagpipe, Banjo, Bass Electric, etc.)
Audio Engineers subcategory dropdown shows options (Boom Operator, Dialogue Editing, Dolby Atmos, etc.)
Profile page video upload modal - category dropdown shows all 6 categories (Musicians, Audio Engineers, Studios, Venues, Comedians, Actors)
Profile page video upload modal - selecting Musicians category shows subcategory dropdown
Profile page video upload modal - subcategory dropdown populated with 38 correct options for Musicians

bugs_fixed.issue: Duplicate 'Swipe up for more' hints showing (6 instead of 1)
bugs_fixed.fix: Added isActive condition to swipe hint rendering - hints now only show on the currently active video

critical_code_review_comments: Swipe hint was showing on all 6 video components because the condition only checked hasSwipedUp state, not whether the video was active
Fix applied: Changed {!hasSwipedUp && (...)} to {isActive && !hasSwipedUp && (...)} to only show hint on active video
VIDEO_CATEGORIES in ProfilePage.js correctly defines 6 categories with subcategories
Subcategory dropdown correctly appears when a category with subcategories is selected
Share modal includes all 5 required options: Facebook, Instagram, X, Reddit, Copy Link
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auditions page and Profile page video upload modal fully tested. Key fix applied: duplicate swipe hints fixed by adding isActive condition. All category tabs with subcategory dropdowns working. Share modal has all 5 options (Facebook, Instagram, X, Reddit, Copy). Video upload modal shows 6 categories and subcategories appear correctly when category is selected. Note: Spotify embed on profile page shows external error (not app code issue).
